title: Jaro-Winkler similarity of string pairs
summary: Compute the Jaro-Winkler similarity (prefix scale 0.1, prefix up to 4) of a batch of 200 string pairs: names, identifiers and addresses with typos.
notes: One operation is 200 similarity calls plus the loop and the output list, which every adapter has alike. Strings are 3 to 28 characters, so per-call overhead (argument conversion in Python and Ruby extensions) is a large part of each figure.
